notes.title: Let the show begin! One Night: Burlesque has a release date!
notes.notes:
Read the minds of others and reveal whose thoughts are the source of your murderous visions! One Night: Burlesque will land on Steam and Nintendo Switch on November 3rd 💋

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/30011892220395da6a8ecb321f68f8a2e385a1a8.jpg

One Night: Burlesque is a hand-drawn, detective visual novel, where the modern world is presented with a noir touch. You will find yourself in deep conversations, making choices based on people's words or on what exactly hides behind their eyes. 👁 👁

Follow the steps of Holly, one of Angels Den's most charismatic dancers, and help her discover who might be targeting her friend. 

There's many people in the club at late night hour – each of them looking for something different, each thinking of something different…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/a3fa321c6d64c49a7a161dde1a6c3034faf6f4b4.jpg

In the world of One Night: Burlesque some people are born with supernatural powers. They keep them at bay using special pills – which the main character, Holly, ran out of tonight. 

With her mind-reading powers at full capacity the initial, bloody thought might not be the only one she hears tonight. Tough there’s a question only you can answer – to read or not to read? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/127dfe50325c46a0b924878b4a5e92e258134d73.jpg

GAME KEY FEATURES:


♦︎ A noir aesthetic ♦︎
♦︎ A detective-style murder mystery ♦︎
♦︎ A unique setting (a Burlesque Club) ♦︎
♦︎ Multiple endings depending on your choices ♦︎
♦︎ An Incredible music track ♦︎
♦︎ A charming telepathic dancer ♦︎

  🍸 🥃 🍹

One Night: Burlesque will be available on Steam and the Nintendo Switch consoles later on NOVEMBER 3RD, and the game is available on Steam Wishlist now. You can also play the demo with the whole Act I!
